name: 53717 · Madison, WI
findings: ZIP 53717 (Madison) has 96 nonprofit organizations. 46 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 40 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53717 (Madison) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 53717 (Madison) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 40 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.
